user.title: Zeekr Charger
user.description: Connect to a Zeekr BLE wallbox charger. The serial number is printed on the charger label (e.g. EC0000XX...). If BLE discovery by name fails, provide the charger's BLE MAC address.

error.serial_too_short: The serial number must be at least 8 characters.
error.invalid_mac: Invalid BLE MAC address. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF or AABBCCDDEEFF.

data.reconnect_max_attempts: Max reconnect attempts before slow retry
data.heartbeat_stale_threshold: Silence window before forcing a reconnect
